description_en: Changes the instance type of a cloud computer and expands the system cloud disk and data cloud disk of the cloud computer
description_zh: 变更云电脑的实例规格，并扩容云电脑的系统盘和数据盘
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-type eds.general.2c8g --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopSpec

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。您可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html 查询最新的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The target instance type. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188882.html to query the instance types supported by cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例规格。您可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188882.html 查询云电脑支持的实例规格
parameters.name: desktop_type

parameters.help_en: The system cloud disk size after the change. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 80 to 500. The value must be a multiple of 10
parameters.help_zh: 变更后的系统盘大小。单位：GiB。取值范围：80~500 GiB，且必须是 10 的整数倍
parameters.name: root_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en:
The data cloud disk size after the change. Unit: GiB.

For non-graphics cloud computers, valid values: 20 to 1020. The value must be a multiple of 10.
For graphics cloud computers, valid values: 40 to 1020. The value must be a multiple of 10
parameters.help_zh:
变更后的数据盘大小。单位：GiB。

非图形型云电脑的数据盘大小取值范围：20~1020 GiB，且必须是 10 的整数倍。
图形型云电脑的数据盘大小取值范围：40~1020 GiB，且必须是 10 的整数倍
parameters.name: user_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment.

Default value: true. Valid values:

true: Automatic payment is enabled. Make sure that your Alibaba Cloud account balance is sufficient. Otherwise, abnormal orders may be generated.
false: Only an order is generated. Automatic payment is not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。

默认值：true。取值范围：

true：自动付费。请确保阿里云账号余额充足，否则订单会产生异常。
false：只生成订单，不自动付费
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The performance level (PL) of the data cloud disk. Default value: PL0.

Valid values:

PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
parameters.help_zh:
数据盘的性能等级（PL）。默认值：PL0。

取值范围：

PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
parameters.name: user_disk_performance_level

fields.help_en: The target system cloud disk size. Valid values: 80 to 500 GiB. The value must be a multiple of 10
fields.help_zh: 目标系统盘大小。取值范围：80~500 GiB，且必须是 10 的整数倍
fields.name: root_disk_size_gib

fields.help_en: The target data cloud disk size. Valid values: 80 to 500 GiB. The value must be a multiple of 10
fields.help_zh: 目标数据盘大小。取值范围：80~500 GiB，且必须是 10 的整数倍
fields.name: user_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

This parameter is not required for non-subscription cloud computers
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

非包年包月云电脑可不传该参数
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the resource ownership in the reseller pattern. This parameter is not required in the non-reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid
